supabase.js is the official Supabase browser library (@supabase/supabase-js, v2.119.2,
UMD build), saved here so the site does not load code from anyone else's server.
It is licensed under the MIT licence: Copyright (c) 2020 Supabase.
It is only loaded when the database is switched on (js/config.js > backend).
To update it, replace this file with a newer dist/umd/supabase.js from the npm package.
